stories.title: US to ‘live stream’ firing squad execution of military base shooter Nidal Hasan

en.title: US to 'live stream' firing squad execution of military base shooter Nidal Hasan
en.summary: The Pentagon will live stream the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan, scheduled for December 3 at Fort Hood. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and injuring 32 others in a 2009 shooting at the military base.

stories.title: China breakthrough projected to push sustainable jet fuel gross profit margin past 50%

en.title: China breakthrough projected to push sustainable jet fuel gross profit margin past 50%
en.summary: Chinese researchers developed a catalyst enabling efficient conversion of synthesis gas into sustainable jet fuel, with potential gross profit margins exceeding 50 percent. The technology was validated in pilot testing and could advance carbon neutrality goals while increasing production capacity.

stories.title: Hong Kong rejects US downgrade to lowest tier in human trafficking report

en.title: Hong Kong rejects US downgrade to lowest tier in human trafficking report
en.summary: The US State Department downgraded Hong Kong to Tier 3, the lowest classification, in its human trafficking report, citing prosecution and victim identification shortcomings. Hong Kong's government disputed the assessment as unfounded.

stories.title: Pentagon unveils US$350 million quantum computing push as China rivalry grows

en.title: Pentagon unveils US$350 million quantum computing push as China rivalry grows
en.summary: The Pentagon announced a 350 million dollar initiative to maintain American leadership in quantum computing amid intensifying US-China competition over military applications of advanced technology.

stories.title: After failed US execution, Christa Pike is walking but mentally ‘foggy’, lawyer says

en.title: After failed US execution, Christa Pike is walking but mentally 'foggy', lawyer says
en.summary: A 50-year-old convicted killer who survived a botched lethal injection last week has regained consciousness and begun walking, though she remains mentally disoriented according to her legal representative.

stories.title: National security must not kill Philippines-China academic ties

en.title: National security must not kill Philippines-China academic ties
en.summary: Approximately 150 Chinese teachers have departed the Philippines following official warnings about security risks from educational and cultural exchanges, disrupting classes and potentially harming bilateral relations.

stories.title: Venezuela’s Maduro and wife Flores tortured US citizens to stay in power: US prosecutors

en.title: Venezuela's Maduro and wife Flores tortured US citizens to stay in power: US prosecutors
en.summary: US prosecutors have filed additional criminal charges against former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores, accusing them of torturing political opponents and American citizens to maintain power.

stories.title: The long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln returns home to San Diego from Middle East

en.title: The long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln returns home to San Diego from Middle East
en.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group has returned to San Diego after a record 265-day deployment supporting operations in the Middle East, during which the Defence Secretary presented the crew with the Presidential Unit Citation.

stories.title: US probes Harvard, Yale, MIT, other universities over alleged visa fraud, with China focus

en.title: US probes Harvard, Yale, MIT, other universities over alleged visa fraud, with China focus
en.summary: The Trump administration is investigating nine US universities for alleged J-1 visa fraud involving Chinese scholars and concerns about the Chinese government. The J-1 program enables temporary authorization for international researchers, scholars, and students to work or conduct research in the United States.

stories.title: German official killed, another injured during firearms inspection

en.title: German official killed, another injured during firearms inspection
en.summary: A government employee was killed and another seriously injured in southern Bavaria when a gun owner opened fire during a routine firearms inspection. The gunman barricaded himself inside a residential building, triggering a major police operation.

stories.title: UK navy sailor appears in London court on charges of spying for Russia

en.title: UK navy sailor appears in London court on charges of spying for Russia
en.summary: A 24-year-old Royal Navy sailor appeared in court facing espionage charges under the National Security Act. He is accused of preparing to disclose protected information and obtaining classified material for a foreign power between November 2024 and May 2025.

stories.title: China’s BYD considering lithium battery plant in Argentina, foreign minister says

en.title: China's BYD considering lithium battery plant in Argentina, foreign minister says
en.summary: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD is evaluating investment opportunities in Argentina's lithium value chain, including battery and energy storage system production. Argentina's foreign minister confirmed discussions with BYD's executive leadership but provided no details on investment amounts or location.

stories.title: HKTDC’s twin electronics fairs put Hong Kong in pole position

en.title: HKTDC's twin electronics fairs put Hong Kong in pole position
en.summary: The 46th Hong Kong Electronics Fair and 29th electronicAsia, running October 13-16 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, are expected to draw approximately 3,200 exhibitors from 15 countries and regions along with numerous international business visitors.

stories.title: Amid battle for AI edge, Hong Kong presses HSBC over Singapore hub decision: sources

en.title: Amid battle for AI edge, Hong Kong presses HSBC over Singapore hub decision: sources
en.summary: Hong Kong and Singapore are competing for artificial intelligence investment leadership, with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority questioning HSBC's decision to establish an AI centre in Singapore despite Hong Kong being HSBC's largest single market.

stories.title: Alibaba’s AI cloud revenue set to surge over 50% as investment blitz pays off: analysts

en.title: Alibaba's AI cloud revenue set to surge over 50% as investment blitz pays off: analysts
en.summary: Alibaba's cloud and artificial intelligence unit is projected to achieve over 50 percent revenue growth for the September quarter, accelerating from 45 percent growth in the previous quarter, according to analyst forecasts.

stories.title: Retail properties offloaded for losses in weak market as revaluations spark bank concerns

en.title: Retail properties offloaded for losses in weak market as revaluations spark bank concerns
en.summary: Hong Kong retail properties are being sold at losses as prices have declined 30 to 70 percent from 2018 peaks, with banks taking a strict approach to debt collection on such assets.

stories.title: Uniqlo sees profits soar in China despite Beijing-Tokyo tensions

en.title: Uniqlo sees profits soar in China despite Beijing-Tokyo tensions
en.summary: Fast Retailing's Uniqlo chain achieved renewed growth and profitability in mainland China during its 2026 financial year despite geopolitical tensions and weak consumer demand in the region.
